title: Identify hidden assumptions
description: Extract unstated premises, definitions and dependencies.
accomplishes: Extract unstated premises, definitions and dependencies. Explain which are factual, value-based or uncertain. Propose practical checks and alternative interpretations without treating every assumption as an error or inventing the author’s intentions.
prompt:
Act as a critical research analyst.

Task: Identify hidden assumptions.

Input context:
- ARGUMENT: [ARGUMENT]
- DECISION: [DECISION]
- EVIDENCE: [EVIDENCE]
- CONSTRAINTS: [CONSTRAINTS]

Extract unstated premises, definitions and dependencies. Explain which are factual, value-based or uncertain. Propose practical checks and alternative interpretations without treating every assumption as an error or inventing the author’s intentions.

Never invent sources, citations or completed research. Inaccessible references remain unverified.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Business-plan assumption review
A proposal assumes that more enquiries will produce more customers, but follow-up capacity and qualification are unknown. Make those dependencies explicit and identify the data needed to test them. Do not infer deception from an incomplete argument. The review clarifies uncertainty; it does not prove the plan will succeed or fail.
